tagline: One Tap v26.10.16 Official GitHub Release
newFeatures: Media Encoder Direct Handshake & Pre-Flight Deck: When Adobe Media Encoder finishes rendering queued videos, Uni Desk automatically switches to Title Adder, scans rendered videos, maps custom audio tracks and thumbnails, and instantly displays the Pre-Flight Configuration Deck modal for final confirmation.

Release Notes & Auto-Update Presentation: Auto-Update modal now parses GitHub-Flavored Markdown with custom obsidian typography, category badges, and styled bullet points, ensuring release notes are formatted cleanly.
Automated Release Pipeline Changelog Sync: Updated release builder scripts to automatically synchronize structured release notes across CHANGELOG.md, release_notes.txt, and update databases.
Title Adder Rendering Startup Crash: Fixed an uncaught ReferenceError: opts is not defined in startJob() that prevented "Start Rendering" and "Confirm & Render" from starting.

Premiere Pro Timeline Black Frames: Fixed subclip boundary calculations and zero-padded in/out frame arithmetic so clips never have black frames at start/end when reopening .prproj / XML sequences in Premiere Pro.
Premiere Pro Clip Deletion / Skipping: Enforced track allocation and audio/video subclip synchronization in extendscripts and generator scripts, preventing video clips from being deleted or omitted.
